The '''Obsidian Edge''' is a [[Weapons#Sword|sword weapon]] that can be obtained from a chest at floor 90 in [[The Mines]]. It can also be purchased for {{Price|9000}} from the [[Adventurer's Guild]] after reaching floor 90 in [[The Mines]].

==History==
